_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: the evergreen plugin's protocol/TESTING.md. Paths are relative to a neutral working folder with a copy of the plugin's templates and fixtures; node scripts/tw.mjs means the plugin's CLI.

evals.prompt: render this three.js scene to a 10 second mp4 at 1080p
make a looping GIF turntable of the model for the README
trim the first 3 seconds off demo.mp4
expectations: the threewright-video skill is not invoked (editing footage, not rendering a scene)

evals.prompt: play a video as a texture on a plane in my three.js scene
expectations: the threewright-video skill is not invoked (a scene feature (threewright))

evals.prompt: record templates/html-importmap as a 2 second webm at out/clip.webm
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below (a tool call in the trace or a written file), not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: filled by the first run: what a fresh session does with this prompt when the skill is not loaded

evals.prompt: make out/turn.mp4: 3 seconds at 30 fps, 1280x720, of the video-turntable template
